_help: Stage set-up. Edit and reload the page. Coordinates are meters: x = left(-)/right(+), y = up, z = toward the audience (+). The curtain line is z = 1.95, the back wall is z = -3.2.

backstage._help: Image shown behind the stage (replaces the dark back wall). Put the file in /public and set image to '/backstage.jpg'. null = plain dark wall.

led._help: LED-wall look. glow: 0 = flat print … 1 = bright glowing screen (highlights bloom, soft halo and light spill on the floor). grid: visible LED dots 0..1. pitch: LEDs per metre.

propLights._help: Fake (cheap) light from the rig above onto objects: a soft beam + a light pool on the floor. No real lights are added.
